nodes.title: Controller foundation
nodes.summary: BLE controls, discovery, OTA, drill setup and results are implemented.
nodes.acceptance: Historical software CI; provider and protocol coverage. Physical phone behavior remains separately open.
nodes.gap: Existing local touch simulation does not model a pod.
nodes.evidence: Historical accepted scope; not re-executed this review
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: Virtual pod lab
nodes.summary: Inject a virtual PodRepository/transport into the real app; use generated messages and deterministic virtual time.
nodes.acceptance: One launch path discovers 2 and 6 virtual identities; real app providers exercise current generated commands, notifications, connection and clock control. Same seed reproduces results. Explicit app virtual model; production drill/timing semantic parity is deferred to FS-WP-004C.
nodes.gap: Must replace direct-touch shortcuts without pretending to emulate RF.
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: Complete simulated phone journey
nodes.summary: Build discovery → setup → drill → results → reconnect as an offline user journey.
nodes.acceptance: Script happy path, inactive touches, timeout, loss, duplicates, disconnect, restart and OTA failure; reproducible fixtures and CI. Label every modeled behavior. Fixtures declare app virtual model fidelity, not production simulator parity.
nodes.gap: No new physical claims from six virtual pods.
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: Shared drill and timing contract
nodes.summary: Reconcile the existing portable peer codec with phone authority, timing, result and recovery semantics.
nodes.acceptance: Generated schema-owned semantics agree across firmware, host and app; exact-head software and required two-board regression retained.
nodes.gap: Portable code exists; phone local scoring and fixed firmware drill still diverge.
nodes.evidence: Implementation or candidate artifacts exist; terminal acceptance unverified
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: App ↔ production simulator parity
nodes.summary: Run the same app scenarios against the production-backed simulator adapter.
nodes.acceptance: Observed command/notification/result traces match the declared shared contract; causality and all modeled exceptions are recorded.
nodes.gap: Depends on qualified target backplane; A and B can proceed before this.
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: Six-node physical app alpha
nodes.summary: Carry the tested app journey onto a real phone and six nodes.
nodes.acceptance: Retain six-node scan/control/touch, disconnect/recovery, timing and soak evidence on supported phones, with explicit peripheral capability inventory.
nodes.gap: Four additional physical nodes and a real-phone campaign required. Direct physical acceptance can proceed without predictive-model qualification.
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: Automated bench foundation
nodes.summary: Two serialized boards have retained control, radio, update and recovery evidence.
nodes.acceptance: Historical Aug 2 campaign plus later recorded automated regressions.
nodes.gap: This is a historical baseline, not current physical closure.
nodes.evidence: Historical accepted scope; not re-executed this review
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: Current identity & recovery baseline
nodes.summary: Bind both boards, exact software images, configuration and restoration state to one campaign.
nodes.acceptance: Before powered load tests, inspect actual populated parts/orientation and safe rails/idle current. Bind exact versions/hashes, diagnostics, all currently discovered self-tests (record the count) and two normal boots; reconcile serial/BLE update recovery separately. Forced rollback requires its own authorization.
nodes.gap: Current exact-build closure and guarded-OTA repair evidence need reconciliation.
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: Observe every peripheral
nodes.summary: Validate physical output and stimulus on each board.
nodes.acceptance: Observer/instrument record for LED colors/brightness, touch/inactive touches, IMU motion, haptic effect and audio/volume; tie each to command and board.
nodes.gap: Accepted commands and initialization do not prove actuation.
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: Measure the operating envelope
nodes.summary: Measure idle, radio and combined peripheral load; correlate physical timing. Preparation and safe measurements can run alongside peripheral tests after NFF1.
nodes.acceptance: Exact parts and instruments; voltage/current/transients/thermal/RF observations; calibrated clock uncertainty for timing. Bound supply and firmware resources.
nodes.gap: NFF USB power cannot prove final battery, charger, RGBW or enclosure behavior.
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: Phone + two-pod fault campaign
nodes.summary: Exercise the real phone workflow, bidirectional radio and recovery under combined load.
nodes.acceptance: Fresh disabled lifecycles, complementary roles/one peer, simulation-off benchmarks both ways; separate traced drill; physical touch, inactive target, timeout, disconnect and stop assertions. Retain serial/BLE/mobile update checks, bounded soak and combined-load fault recovery, with stale-result rejection.
nodes.gap: Round-trip timings are not synchronized one-way latency; two pods do not prove six.
nodes.invalidates: Changes to the owning behavior, protocol, configuration or evidence identity reopen acceptance.

nodes.title: HR0 · Measured NFF reference

Architecture, mechanical envelope and interface record

Power, thermal, runtime and memory budgets
FMEA, RF/compliance route and risk coupons
Firmware board profile and service interface plan

No unresolved critical architecture or simulator/hardware divergence
Immutable release package plus separately recorded CEO spend decision

decisions.title: Assign the hardware design owner
decisions.when: Before HW design accountability or paid work
decisions.recommendation: Name a qualified electrical design owner and set a bounded definition / instrumentation budget.
decisions.alternative: Keep AI desk definition moving; defer paid work and freeze decisions.
decisions.consequence: G1 has no credible delivery forecast until ownership, access and capacity are recorded.

decisions.title: Confirm the first product envelope
decisions.recommendation: Use the existing six-pod, indoor, offline-first phone-controlled kit as the planning hypothesis; confirm launch phone platforms and first market.
decisions.alternative: Reduce kit or launch-platform scope explicitly; reallocate requirements before part selection.
decisions.consequence: Battery, charging, enclosure, validation and app-release scope remain assumptions.

decisions.title: Choose the next lab budget after the setup spec
decisions.when: After HW-WP-002 produces a costed proposal
decisions.recommendation: Retain both NFFs; add shared measurement access and four economical radio nodes for six-node scale, with explicit peripheral limitations.
decisions.alternative: Borrow instruments or use a shared lab; buy additional nodes only for the scale campaign.
decisions.consequence: Two boards can retire current integration risks, but cannot establish six-node behavior.

gaps.title: App simulation bypasses the device contract
gaps.detail: sim-pod-* and simulateTouch() exercise local drill logic. A virtual repository/transport, virtual clock and repeatable fault scenarios are still missing.

gaps.title: Command success is ahead of physical proof
gaps.detail: Historical serial/BLE/radio/OTA campaigns passed, but light, touch, motion, vibration, sound and measured electrical behavior are not closed for both boards.

gaps.title: Merged trace work lacks reconciled acceptance
gaps.detail: PR 105 merged Aug 17. The ledger names candidate 2772f633; the PR describes reviewed 2d136ac4 but reports final head c9ba6ee8. Merge activity alone cannot close the exact-artifact acceptance gap.

gaps.title: Simulation code has outrun its status ledger
gaps.detail: Retained issue-142 backplane traces exist while the prior ledger calls F Not due. Operational predictive entry is explicitly rejected because terminal G/H evidence is absent. Reconcile acceptance; predictive claims remain prohibited.

gaps.title: This checkout trails remote main
gaps.detail: Reviewed local source is 0f1659c. Remote main CI passed 3b62a6c on Aug 29. That newer simulation repair was not imported into this dirty checkout; its current behavior requires source reconciliation.

gaps.title: Old forecasts are no longer credible commitments
gaps.detail: Aug 24 characterization and Aug 31 downselect targets elapsed without accepted closure. G1 retains its Sep 15 baseline; current forecast is unset until measurements, owner, resources and scope are known.
